title: runtime: quant cold-start operator throttling & telemetry gaps causing crash-loop and accuracy skew
creator: Aisha Johnson
description: Summary: During a regional traffic spike on 2025-11-10 we observed an increased rate of model serving crash-loops and silent accuracy skew for int4-quantized model variants. The immediate symptom was operator-level timeouts and repeated fallbacks to slower float execution paths, which temporarily increased tail latency and produced outputs outside expected QA thresholds for a subset of prompt families. This ticket consolidates the investigation, short-term mitigations, and longer-term engineering action items to prevent recurrence.
timeline: 2025-11-10 03:42 UTC — Alerts: increased 95th/99th latency and repeated process restarts in us-west-2 cluster (runtime-gpu-pool-7).
2025-11-10 03:47 UTC — Pager duty acknowledged; on-call triage identified pattern: crashes concentrated on int4 model variants during cold-start under high concurrent initialization.
2025-11-10 04:05 UTC — Emergency mitigation: temporarily pinned affected routes to int8 variant and enabled conservative batching (reduced max_batch_size), which reduced crash rate and tail latency.

2025-11-10 05:20 UTC — Deployed telemetry patch to increase operator init timeout and emit per-op init histogram. Immediate signal improved but accuracy drift remained for ~90 minutes for some eval prompt sets.
2025-11-11 — Post-incident canary runs showed intermittent replayed failures when simulating concurrent cold starts at scale.
root_cause: A race between weight deserialization and operator initialization combined with aggressive operator init throttling under high parallel cold-starts. Certain int4 weight layout paths left the operator-scale metadata uninitialized for a short window, producing nondeterministic kernel selection that triggered fallback to untested slow paths and, in a few cases, NaN-producing math under rare rounding sequences. Additionally, telemetry lacked per-operator init timing and a cold-start concurrency metric, delaying detection and correlation with KV-cache eviction patterns.
mitigation_summary: Short-term: pin affected production routes to int8 and reduce parallel cold-starts via gradual ramping, increase operator init timeouts, and deploy additional telemetry to capture per-op init and scale init events. Long-term: add deterministic init ordering, guardrails around uninitialized operator metadata, stronger canary scenarios that include concurrent cold-start stress, and improvements to the quant converter verification matrix.
action_items: A1 — Add deterministic operator init barrier and assert metadata populated before kernel selection (owner: Marco Rivera, estimate: 3, due: 2025-11-22, status: in-progress).
A2 — Implement per-operator init telemetry histograms and cold-start concurrency gauge; hook into Console alerting (owner: Priya Desai, estimate: 2, due: 2025-11-18, status: done).
A3 — Expand nightly canary to include parallel cold-start scenario at production-like concurrency for int4/int3 variants (owner: Evan Park, estimate: 5, due: 2025-12-02, status: planned).
A4 — Add preflight converter checks that validate operator metadata for quantized weight layouts and fail-fast in CI (owner: Lihua Chen, estimate: 3, due: 2025-11-30, status: in-review).

A5 — Update rollout policy: require 24-hour concurrency stress in canary before broad rollout of new quant converter or kernel changes (owner: Product - Maya Singh, estimate: 1, due: 2025-11-19, status: agreed).
A6 — Retroactively audit recent quant-related merges for missing telemetry or init ordering assumptions and open follow-ups (owner: Marco Rivera, estimate: 2, due: 2025-11-25, status: in-progress).
telemetry_notes: Deployed temporary per-op init timers and a cold-start concurrency gauge on 2025-11-10 05:20 UTC; these surfaced correlation between KV-cache evictions and concurrent operator inits. Missing signals we will add: kernel-selection decision trace, weight-deserialization timestamps, and a per-request fallback-reason field (reason codes for fallback to float path).
